snippet.title: The 9th Charnel – Official Announcement Trailer | New Horror Adventure Game (2025)
snippet.description:
#The9thCharnel #HorrorGame #SurvivalHorror 
Prepare to descend into darkness... "The 9th Charnel" is an upcoming horror adventure game that will challenge your mind and shake your soul. Watch the official announcement trailer now and get a first look at the eerie world, haunting environments, and chilling story that await.

Join to the Discord: https://discord.gg/soedesco to stay tune!

This psychological horror game blends atmospheric exploration, disturbing lore, and intense survival elements. What is the 9th Charnel? And why were you chosen?

Features glimpsed in the trailer:
Immersive, story-driven horror
Mind-bending puzzles and exploration
A surreal, nightmarish art style
Mysterious characters and a cryptic narrative

#The9thCharnel #HorrorGame #IndieGame #GameTrailer #SurvivalHorror #PsychologicalHorror

Follow SOEDESCO®!
Discord: https://discord.gg/soedesco
Website: http://www.soedesco.com/
Newsletter: https://bit.ly/2wsfR4f
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Soedesco
Twitter: https://twitter.com/soedesco
Instagram: https://instagram.com/soedesco

Video editors: 
@DanielFigaresYT 
@juanfranrivero

About SOEDESCO:
SOEDESCO is an independent video game developer, publisher, and distributor founded in 2002 by Soedesh Chauthi with its headquarters in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, and offices in Madrid, Spain & Pilsen, Czech Republic. We deliver creative content across multiple genres and platforms for a worldwide audience in physical and digital formats.
